2. The facts leading to the issuance of the Rule in a nutshell can be stated thus, the present opposite party No. I instituted the original suit before 3d Court of learned Assistant Judge, Gazipur for preemption (Wu) under Mahomedan Law contending inter Witt that the case land originally belonged to one Akter uddin and the corresponding S.A. and R.S. khatian was prepared in his name. Akter Uddin died leaving behind two sons namely Md. Taizul Haq who is the plaintiff of the suit and one Abdul Miah. Akter Uddin had also a daughter namely Jahanara Begum and all of them inherited the property. The plaintiff and the defendant no.2 Jahanara Begum are step brother and sister. On 01.08.2001 the -defendant No.1 coming to the suit land started to demarcate the some by survey. Finding that; the plaintiff asked him the cause of such demarcation and from the reply of the defendant No.1 the plaintiff came to learn that he (defendant No.1) has purchased 4(four) decimals of land from the defendant No.2. The plaintiff made a protest and resisted the defendants and observed the formalities of "sufa "(pre-emption). After citing the certified copy of the kabla on 10.05.2001 the plaintiff filed the original suit for getting the suit land pre-empted under Mahomedan Law. The case of the plaintiff is such that he has observed "Man-E-Ishad " and "Talab-E-Muashabotl. The -purchaser defendant No.1 is a stranger to the suit land and he has no adjacent land. 

 14. Scrutinizing the evidence I find that the plaintiff Md. Taizul Hoque as witness No.1 tried to corroborate his plaint case. The respective khatian showing the ownership of his father is not denied in this case and it is also not denied from any corner that the plaintiff is a co-sharer by inheritance in the case jote. To substantiate the case of the plaintiff analyzing his pleadings it transpires that within the four corners of the pleadings there is no such averment as to what number of witnesses were present at the time of observance of the required formalities.
